messages.subject: Version 1.1-5 now online
parts:
I have uploaded version 1.1-5 today, please see package news for list of specific updates.

I have more expansions in preparation, but will wait for a scientific journal to accept my supporting evidence for publication. If successful, this process usually takes between 3 and 6 months.

Thank you all for using the package and please do not forget to cite the package and related publications when you use it.
 
Vincent
